schema_documentation:
41 keys, all present in 100% of the 7,036 records (many are empty-string rather than absent). Grouped:

| group | keys | notes |
|---|---|---|
| identity | `subject_id`, `subject_key`, `subject_name` (100% non-empty), `subject_url` | |
| meeting | `city_id`, `city_name`, `city_name_en`, `meeting_id`, `meeting_name`, `meeting_date` (ISO), `meeting_url`, `meeting_agenda_url` (96.5%), `meeting_video_url` (98.0%), `meeting_audio_url` (98.3%), `meeting_youtube_url` (98.3%) | 25 cities |
| topic | `topic_id` (97.5%), `topic_name` (97.5%), `topic_name_en` (97.5%), `agenda_item_index` (69.9%) | |
| content | `description` str 100% non-empty, `context` str 59.35% non-empty, `location_text` (45.4%), `introduced_by_id` / `introduced_by_name` (39.6%) | |
| decision | `decision_ada`, `decision_title`, `decision_pdf_url`, `decision_publish_date`, `decision_protocol_number` | each ~12.6% non-empty |
| votes | `votes_for`, `votes_against`, `votes_abstain`, `attendance_present`, `attendance_absent` | float, mostly NaN |
| transcript | `full_transcript_text` str **46.8% non-empty (3,293/7,036)**, `statement_count`, `speaker_turn_count`, `utterance_count` int | |
| **JSON-in-string** | `statements_json`, `speaker_turns_json` | see nesting |
| **composite** | `text` str 100% non-empty | the single training field |
semantic_meaning: Municipal council agenda items from 25 Greek cities with AI summaries and raw ASR transcripts of the debates.
